messages:
Sasha (PM): Quick sync 1 Optimize playbook reprioritization: batching, prefix caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. Customer asks: cut token cost, mobile P95 <100ms, and faster regression detection. Propose 3 lanes: Cost / Latency / Quality. Need 31 clear launch gates by Friday. Thoughts?

Ishaan (Eng): Agreed. Split batching: runtime continuous batching (server) vs SDK/client batching presets. Runtime gives bigger savings but needs tail-latency controls.

Marta (ML): For quant rollouts, ship "safe presets" (q4a, fp16) and a small perf/quality matrix per-model. Start with Llama2 variants + two community models. Eval harness is required before customer trials.

Priya (Solutions): Customers want a simple Console control: "Conserve / Balanced / Low latency" with defaults and a one-page migration checklist for Dedicated. I'll draft sample wording.

Leo (SRE): Ops guardrails: must have canary path, per-route P95/P99 dashboards, token-cost telemetry, and circuit-breaker SLOs. Define automated rollback triggers (P99 increase or eval-alert spike).

Sasha (PM): Draft minimal gates: 1) Quant perf matrix + docs for top-3 models; 2) Batching policy + canary + SLO override; 3) Prefix caching opt-in + correctness tests; 4) Eval-alerts prototype + runbook. Keep gates small so we can ship incrementally.

Ishaan (Eng): We'll include explicit acceptance metrics in the tech spec: token reduction % (per-customer), P95 ceiling (<100ms mobile), and allowed eval-metric delta.

Marta (ML): Use relative, customer-specific thresholds (e.g., task recall drop <2%) and a short human spot-check cadence for initial weeks.

Priya (Solutions): I'll map pilot customers: RetailCo (cost-first, target 30% token cut), MedLab (accuracy-first), MobileCo (latency-first). Will produce impact matrix and one-pagers.

Leo (SRE): Rollout recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 24-48h; automated rollback if eval-alert rate >2% or P99 delta >50ms. Add a tiny chaos test for prefix-cache correctness.

ci-bot: ci-bot created epic RDW-1729 and linked PRD https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1729 :rocket:

Sasha (PM): Next steps: Ishaan+Marta => tech spec + bench plan by Tue EOD; Priya => pilot one-pagers; Leo => SLO guardrails + dashboards. Prioritization workshop Thurs 10am. Post blockers here. :+1:
